name: customer-magic
description: Set up your revenue sources in the agent you already work in, then run your pipeline from it: eight playbooks for importing a list, keeping a CRM in step, closing out an event, working today's follow-ups, logging a call, the weekly review, handing deals over, and a background review of everything that comes in. Includes the Customer Magic connection, so the work persists between sessions instead of dying with the chat.
